## EMST role: Environmental compliance inspector (state variant, senior level; P1)

*Match:* `skos:broadMatch`, confidence 0.5, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R12-environmental-compliance-inspector/state:2653`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Conduct regulatory compliance inspections — senior L3
- Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases — senior L3
- Target inspections and verify compliance using monitoring data and analytics — senior L3
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — senior L3
- Build and maintain a defensible administrative record — senior L3
- Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites — senior L2
- Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary — senior L3
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — senior L3
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — senior L3
- Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments — senior L2
- Record field observations with protocol fidelity and data integrity — senior L2
- Assure the quality of environmental data from collection to release — senior L2
- Maintain the integrity of regulatory and scientific findings under institutional pressure — senior L3
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — senior L2
- Evaluate and certify others' task performance against position standards — senior L3
- Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field — senior L1
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — senior L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — senior L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — senior L1
- Supervise staff and volunteers in environmental work — senior L3
- Communicate technical environmental information in writing and speech — senior L3

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Plan a compliance inspection from the facility's permit, compliance history and monitoring reports, listing the conditions to verify and the evidence to collect
- Inspect a permitted facility or site against its permit conditions and applicable rules, recording observations, measurements and samples as evidence
- Collect samples and photographs during an inspection under chain-of-custody procedures, so that the evidence is admissible in an enforcement proceeding
- Write an inspection report stating findings of fact for each condition inspected, separating the inspector's observations from conclusions
- Select the response the enforcement policy sets for each inspection finding, issuing a notice of violation, assistance letter or referral
- Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection
- Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check
- Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them
- Defend field sampling and custody procedures in declarations or testimony when sample results are challenged in enforcement or litigation
- Investigate a reported environmental violation, establishing the facts, responsible party and applicable requirement before recommending an enforcement response
- Assemble the evidence file for an enforcement case, linking each alleged violation to the inspection findings, records and samples that prove it
- Testify as a fact or expert witness in an enforcement proceeding, explaining the evidence and methods behind each finding

*Credential gates (issuer verified):* 2 not shown until the issuer is verified

## EMST role: Environmental permit writer (state variant, journey/senior level; P1)

*Match:* `skos:broadMatch`, confidence 0.5, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R11-environmental-permit-writer/state:2653`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Issue environmental permits and resource-use authorizations as the deciding authority — journey L2, senior L3
- Draft enforceable, implementable binding instruments — journey L2, senior L3
- Map the decision authority and procedural pathway for a proposed action — journey L2, senior L3
- Build and maintain a defensible administrative record — journey L2, senior L3
- Negotiate permit conditions, mitigation and agreements using interest-based methods — journey L2, senior L3
- Process permit applications and administer issued authorizations — journey L2, senior L3
- Operate within, or oversee, delegated and assumed regulatory programs — journey L2, senior L3
- Track regulatory change and translate it into operating guidance — journey L2, senior L3
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L2, senior L3
- Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments — journey L2, senior L2
- Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary — journey L2, senior L3
- Maintain the integrity of regulatory and scientific findings under institutional pressure — journey L2, senior L3
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — journey L2, senior L2
- Assess litigation exposure and design decisions for resilience on remand — senior L3
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — journey L1, senior L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — journey L1, senior L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — journey L1, senior L1
- Supervise staff and volunteers in environmental work — senior L3
- Design accessible, inclusive public engagement and services — journey L2, senior L3

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Review a permit application for administrative and technical completeness, issuing a deficiency notice that lists each missing element and its basis
- Derive permit limits and conditions from the applicable technical standards and the facility's technical record, documenting the calculation basis for each limit
- Draft a permit and its fact sheet so that each condition is measurable, enforceable and traceable to its legal or technical basis
- Review an AI-drafted permit or fact sheet against the application record and permit template, correcting each condition that lacks a traceable basis
- Respond to public comments on a draft permit, revising conditions where a comment shows an error and explaining each decision in the response document
- Write policy or instrument language that states each obligation, obligated party, deadline and verification method so that compliance can be determined
- Test draft permit conditions or agreement terms against compliance-verification and legal-challenge scenarios, recording each term revised and why
- Verify each term of an AI-generated first draft of an instrument against the governing authority and record before the draft enters review
- Review a project proposal to identify every authorization, consultation and review it triggers, recording the governing procedure version for each
- Prepare an authority map and pathway plan for a multi-permit project, sequencing concurrent and dependent decisions and identifying the critical path
- Negotiate permit conditions or mitigation with an applicant, generating options that meet the governing requirements and recording the agreed terms
- Prepare a negotiation brief stating own and counterpart interests, alternatives to agreement, the issue list and the limits of one's authority

*Credential gates (issuer verified):* 1 not shown until the issuer is verified

## EMST role: Environmental review specialist (state variant, senior level; P1)

*Match:* `skos:broadMatch`, confidence 0.4, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R10-environmental-review-specialist/state:2653`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Conduct environmental impact review of proposed actions — senior L3
- Select, justify and document the appropriate level of environmental review — senior L3
- Build and maintain a defensible administrative record — senior L3
- Direct and evaluate applicant- or contractor-prepared environmental documents — senior L3
- Coordinate lead, cooperating and participating agencies to a shared schedule — senior L3
- Assess effects on protected species and conduct interagency consultation on proposed actions — senior L3
- Review effects of proposed actions on historic properties and resolve them through consultation — senior L3
- Assess litigation exposure and design decisions for resilience on remand — senior L3
- Analyze regulatory, planning and public-comment text at scale with traceable citations — senior L3
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — senior L3
- Analyze cumulative burdens and distributional effects of environmental decisions — senior L3
- Design proportionate public engagement when participation is discretionary — senior L2
- Identify and analyze the parties affected by or interested in a decision — senior L2
- Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions — senior L2
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — senior L2
- Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary — senior L2
- Maintain the integrity of regulatory and scientific findings under institutional pressure — senior L3
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — senior L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — senior L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — senior L1
- Supervise staff and volunteers in environmental work — senior L3
- Practise cultural humility in community, field and team work — senior L3
- Design accessible, inclusive public engagement and services — senior L3
- Build working partnerships with communities affected by environmental decisions — senior L3

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Prepare an environmental assessment of a proposed action, analyzing the reasonably foreseeable effects of the action and its alternatives within the procedure's page and time limits
- Scope the review of a proposed action with cooperating agencies and the public, setting the purpose, alternatives and effects boundaries the analysis will cover
- Lead an interdisciplinary team through an environmental review, assigning resource analyses and reconciling conflicting findings into one effects analysis
- Verify AI-drafted sections of an environmental document against the project record, correcting unsupported statements and recording which text was machine-drafted
- Write the decision document for a reviewed action, explaining how the analyzed effects, alternatives and public comments informed the choice made
- Prepare a joint environmental review document that satisfies both state and federal review procedures for one action, mapping each procedural requirement to its section
- Determine whether a proposed action requires an environmental assessment or a full impact statement, documenting the significance reasoning in the project record
- Screen a proposed action against the agency's exclusion categories and extraordinary-circumstance criteria, recording the screening result and its basis for the official
- Review automated exclusion-screening results for a batch of routine actions, confirming or overriding each flagged extraordinary circumstance
- Adopt another agency's exclusion category for a proposed action where procedures allow, documenting why the actions are comparable
- Evaluate a sponsor-prepared environmental document for adequacy and objectivity, returning specific deficiencies the preparer must correct before adoption
- Document the agency's independent evaluation of a sponsor-prepared document before adoption, recording what was verified and what was changed

## EMST role: Air quality specialist (state variant, journey/senior level; P2)

*Match:* `skos:relatedMatch`, confidence 0.35, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R28-air-quality-specialist/state:2653`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Build emissions inventories and air quality models for attainment planning — journey L2, senior L3
- Operate ambient air monitoring networks to regulatory quality-assurance criteria — journey L2, senior L3
- Issue environmental permits and resource-use authorizations as the deciding authority — journey L2, senior L3
- Conduct regulatory compliance inspections — journey L2, senior L3
- Operate within, or oversee, delegated and assumed regulatory programs — journey L2, senior L3
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — journey L2, senior L3
- Plan smoke management for prescribed and managed fire within air quality requirements — journey L2, senior L3
- Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases — journey L2, senior L3
- Build organizational and jurisdictional greenhouse gas inventories for disclosure and reporting — journey L2, senior L3
- Analyze cumulative burdens and distributional effects of environmental decisions — journey L2, senior L3
- Build, run and validate environmental forecast and scenario systems — journey L2, senior L3
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — journey L1, senior L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — journey L1, senior L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L1, senior L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — journey L1, senior L1

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Compile a point, area, mobile and natural source emissions inventory for a planning year with documented methods and activity data
- Run a photochemical model for an attainment demonstration under an approved modelling protocol, documenting model performance against monitored data
- Review a permit applicant's dispersion modelling analysis against the agreed protocol and guidance before accepting its conclusions
- Check emissions estimates generated automatically from activity or sensor data against source tests and inventory methods before inclusion
- Determine whether a proposed modification at a stationary source triggers major new source review from emissions increases and netting
- Draft operating permit conditions for a major stationary air source with monitoring sufficient to show compliance with each applicable requirement
- Review a control technology determination submitted with an air permit application against comparable sources and cost criteria
- Check permit conditions drafted from a template or AI tool against the source's applicable requirements before public notice
- Audit a regulatory air monitor's flow and gas calibration against transfer standards following the quality assurance project plan
- Validate a quarter's ambient monitoring data against quality-assurance criteria, flagging or invalidating values before data certification
- Collocate low-cost sensors with a regulatory monitor to derive correction factors, documenting sensor performance before the data are published
- Inspect a permitted facility or site against its permit conditions and applicable rules, recording observations, measurements and samples as evidence

*Credential gates (issuer verified):* 1 not shown until the issuer is verified
